usage: sot-validator firmware-check [-h] --snapshot SNAPSHOT --catalog CATALOG
                                    [--snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE]
                                    [--evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME]
                                    [--output-json OUTPUT_JSON] [--output-md OUTPUT_MD]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --snapshot SNAPSHOT   Site JSON snapshot file or SnapshotStore directory (repeatable).
  --catalog CATALOG     Lifecycle catalog JSON of firmware baselines and end-of-sale / end-of-
                        support dates.
  --snmp-fixture SNMP_FIXTURE
                        Optional SNMP fixture JSON supplying sysDescr by IP; without it every
                        device is unparsed.
  --evaluation-time EVALUATION_TIME
                        Reference ISO-8601 timestamp (naive means UTC; default: now).
  --output-json OUTPUT_JSON
                        Output path for the firmware report JSON.
  --output-md OUTPUT_MD
                        Output path for the firmware report Markdown.
